topics.title: Benefit Plan Structure, Features and Investments
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to analyze different types of designs for retirement plans and retirement plan investments.

outcomes.text: Describe the structure of the following plans:
bullets: Other alternative retirement plans such as executive retirement plans, shared risk plans, target benefit plans, etc.

outcomes.text: Given a plan type, explain the relevance and range of plan features including the following:
bullets: Benefit / contribution formula, including methods of integration with benefits provided by social insurance
Payment options and associated adjustments to the amount of benefit
Benefit subsidies and their value, vested or non-vested

outcomes.text: Discuss investment of retirement plan assets
bullets: Assess the different types and combinations of investment vehicles typically used for providing retirement benefits.
Distinguish the various strategies, approaches and techniques used to manage retirement fund assets

topics.title: Benefit Plan Design Recommendation
topics.objective: The candidate will understand how to evaluate sponsors’ goals for the retirement plan, evaluate alternative plan types and features, and recommend a plan design appropriate to address those goals.

outcomes.text: Describe ways to identify and prioritize the sponsor’s goals related to the design of the retirement plan
Assess the tradeoffs between different goals
Assess the feasibility of achieving the sponsor’s goals for their retirement plan
State relationships or recognize contradictions between a sponsor’s plan design goals and retirement risks faced by retirees
State relationship or recognize contradictions between sponsor’s goals and taxpayers’ perspective when evaluating benefit plan design
Identify the ways that regulation impacts the sponsor’s plan design goals
Design retirement programs that manage retirement risk, are consistent with sponsor’s objectives and promote employee behavior consistent with sponsor’s objectives.
Evaluate the pros and cons from both a sponsor and employee perspective of introducing options that impact the labor force demographics
Recommend a method to integrate benefits provided by social insurance with retirement plan designs in order to meet the plan sponsor’s particular goals and defend the recommendation
Recommend an appropriate plan type and plan design features for providing retirement benefits and defend the recommendations
Assess the potential effects, including tax implications, of various investments and investment policies on all of the stakeholders
Identify and assess the sources of investment risk applicable to retirement fund assets

Explain and apply restrictions on plan design features to a proposed plan design, taking into accounting the use of tax incentives and understanding conflicts between regulations and design objectives
Identify changes that could reduce sponsor risk.
